title: Reports of consignment sales.
bodyText: Every commission merchant shall make a written report to the producer for farm produce handled on consignment on behalf of said producer, within the time and manner as may be prescribed by the department. Making a false or incorrect report shall constitute a misdemeanor under section 145-12.
bodyHtml: §145-5  Reports of consignment sales.  Every commission merchant shall make a written report to the producer for farm produce handled on consignment on behalf of said producer, within the time and manner as may be prescribed by the department.  Making a false or incorrect report shall constitute a misdemeanor under section 145-12. [L 1951, c 74, pt of §1; RL 1955, §23-5; HRS §145-5; am L 1972, c 39, §3; am L 2025, c 235, §27]
